newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia palm olein stable in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia palm olein stable in late trade.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices were mostly stable in late trading on Friday, with gains in Malaysia improving sentiment, traders said.
They said palm olein was quoted at 1,350 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, unchanged from the opening, but trades were also heard at 1,355 rupiah and in the lower range of 1,340-45 rupiah.
The traders also said the industry was anxiously waiting for details of the government's economic deregulation package, expected to be announced next week.

"I am wondering if the deregulation package is going to touch on the export tax on crude palm oil and products," one trader said. "This month's export taxes have not been announced yet by the government and I am wondering if it is being held back because of the deregulation package."
An official at the finance ministry, which issues the monthly taxes, said the rates might be announced next week.
The export taxes were introduced in September 1994 in a bid to ensure sufficient local supply and stable prices.
